title: QC Chemistry Supervisor
description:
Supervisez une équipe dédiée à la qualité des nos analyses chimiques et contribuez directement à ce que des traitements vitaux atteignent nos patients en toute sécurité.
Votre nouveau rôle

Au quotidien, vos responsabilités incluront :
Superviser les activités quotidiennes de votre équipe de 8-12 techniciens, en établissant les priorités pour assurer l'achèvement des tâches dans les délais impartis
Garantir que chaque membre de votre équipe délivre ses activités en accord avec le planning et lead-times préalablement définis, tout en mesurant la performance individuelle et collective
Assurer la traçabilité des activités et l'intégrité des données, en relayant une culture qualité visant à ce que chacun réalise ses activités en accord avec la documentation, la réglementation et les principes cGMP/ALCOA+
Gérer et coordonner les projets de développement, d'optimisation et de validation des méthodes d’analyse chimique, en créant, révisant et approuvant la documentation associée
Revoir et approuver les déviations, OOS/OOT et Change Controls liés aux activités de votre équipe, en garantissant la clôture des actions qualité dans les temps impartis
Représenter l'équipe lors des inspections et réunions internes/externes, en préparant les membres de votre équipe et en impliquant les experts internes au besoin
Développer les membres de votre équipe à travers la création et le suivi des plans de formation (TMP) et l'évaluation régulière de la performance
Votre nouveau département
Au sein de CMC & Product Supply, vous rejoindrez le département Contrôle Qualité sur notre site de Bruxelles. Notre laboratoire QC joue un rôle essentiel dans la libération des produits destinés aux patients, en garantissant les plus hauts standards de qualité et de conformité réglementaire. Votre équipe chimie est au cœur de cette mission, assurant l'introduction de nouvelles méthodes et le maintien de l'excellence opérationnelle.
Vos compétences et qualifications
Nous recherchons un Superviseur QC Chemistry qui saura conjuguer expertise technique et leadership d'équipe dans un environnement pharmaceutique exigeant. Vous apporterez avec vous :
Un diplôme en chimie, biologie ou autre discipline scientifique pertinente
Une expérience de minimum 4ans dans un laboratoire d’analyse chimique avec une première expérience en gestion de personnel
Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais à l'oral, à l'écrit et en lecture
De solides compétences en gestion d'équipe et en communication, avec la capacité d'interagir avec divers départements et fonctions
Une excellente gestion des priorités, avec un esprit réactif et une aptitude à résoudre les problèmes
Une grande rigueur et une forte capacitée d'adaptation aux changements, avec résilience
La connaissance des cGMP, règles ALCOA+ et de la réglementation relative au domaine d'activités constitue un atout

description:

Payment Specialist
Athens, Greece
Clinical Operations.
Would you like to play a key role in ensuring smooth and compliant clinical trial payments? Are you a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working in a dynamic and cross-functional environment?
Then you could be our new Payment Specialist. Apply now and join us for a life-changing career! The role is based in Athens, Greece and reports to the Start Up Manager within Clinical Operations.
Your new role
As a Payment Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and executing end-to-end investigator and site payment processes within clinical trials. • Ensure timely and accurate processing of payments, including tracking and reconciliation of payment activities.
• Maintain and update payment data in relevant systems, ensuring high data quality and accuracy.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of payment processes.
• Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve payment-related issues and discrepancies.
• Support budget tracking and provide input to financial planning where relevant.

• Contribute to continuous improvement and optimization of payment processes.

Our environment is characterized by a global network with challenging assignments in a project centric organization. We focus on continuous personal and professional development and exciting opportunities which arise within or international organization.
Your skills & qualifications
We're looking for a detail-oriented Payment Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment. You'll bring with you:
• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, science, or related field.
• Demonstrated experience in clinical trials, pharmaceutical industry, or financial operations.
• Strong business acumen with excellent organizational and analytical skills, able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and ensuring high-quality outcomes.
• Technical aptitude in using electronic payment systems and related digital tools, with ability to ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, regulatory standards, and company policies.
• Fluency in English (the interview will be in English).

description:

For more than 100 years, Novo Nordisk has been tackling the unmet medical needs of people living with serious chronic diseases, such as diabetes & obesity. Being part of Novo Nordisk allows our employees to embark on the opportunity to help improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world.
Our new Petersburg, Virginia site marks a strategic move to advance our capabilities in Emerging Technologies (ET) within Chemical API development and production. The highly experienced site is designed to strengthen and accelerate our Small Molecule (SMOL) strategy while amplifying our operational capacity. This is to safeguard and support ET´s SMOL projects in the coming years, aligning with our vision and strengthening our potential for growth and innovation.
What we offer you:
Leading pay and annual performance bonus for all positions
All employees enjoy generous paid time off including 14 paid holidays
Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance – effective day one
Guaranteed 8% 401K contribution plus individual company match option
Family Focused Benefits including 14 weeks paid parental & 6 weeks paid family medical leave
Free access to Novo Nordisk-marketed pharmaceutical products
Tuition Assistance
Life & Disability Insurance
Employee Referral Awards
At Novo Nordisk, you will find opportunities, resources, and mentorship to help grow and build your career. Are you ready to realize your potential? Join Team Novo Nordisk and help us make what matters.
The Position
The Research Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing new or revised processes for active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) or API intermediate for large scale production in cooperation with the pilot-plant, Engineering, and Production department.
This person will take promising chemical processes and scale them up—moving from grams to multi-kilogram batches—while optimizing for safety, speed, and yield. This is a hands-on role that requires a strong knowledge of chemistry and chemical engineer.
Relationships
Reports to Director of R&D Emerging technologies
Essential Functions
Independently drive lab-based activities and scientific reporting innovations, evaluate parameters critical to the process and make recommendations, and effectively communicate results to key stakeholders
Deliver assigned work packages and adhere to project objectives and timelines and ongoing interaction with a range of internal and external stakeholders
Troubleshoot entry-level complexity tasks for a given lab method or technology
Perform hands-on work for process familiarization, process characterization, fate and purge studies, etc.
Set study timelines to meet project deliverables, communicating study updates, as well as data generation, analyses, and reporting
Responsible for drafting reports & protocols with limited assistance from supervisor beyond reviews
Optimize existing processes with aim for improving sustainability, process safety and full manufacturing cost
Work closely with project teams as well as project managers to adhere to project timelines and supply demands
Support the site to maintain their license to operate, including supporting in inspections and audits
Support the process for solving complex technical or operational issues
Collaborate with production on process implementation and execution
Support the establishment and/or expansion of laboratory facilities
May represent team or project at external conference
Follow all safety & environmental requirements in the performance of duties
Other duties as assigned
Physical Requirements
Moves equipment &/or supplies weighing up to 33 pounds within the facility using various body positions. Ability to do close precision work with their hands. Must be able to remain in a stationary position (sitting and standing) 50% of the time. May required corrected vision to 20/25 based on role. May require color vision based on role. Occasionally ascends/descends a ladder. May be required to work at elevated heights. Occasionally works around odorous &/or hazardous materials.
Qualifications
Master’s Degree with four (4) years of relevant experience or a PhD with zero (0) industry or post-doctorate experience required, degrees within Chemical Engineering or Organic Chemistry highly preferred
May consider candidates with a Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering or relevant field of study from an accredited university with a minimum of six (6) years of experience in industrial process chemistry required, preferably within a pharmaceutical company
Relevant experience includes:
Experience and understanding of API Development, e.g. route scouting & development, scale-up, process characterization and implementation for pilot plant scale-up
Knowledge of the theory and techniques of scientific and industrial pharmacy
Knowledge of chemistry activities in the lab through all phases of development up to and including commercial products
Quality and safety mindset and excellent analytical skills
Strong verbal & written communication skills, including presentation skills
Proven process improvement & problem-solving skills
Preferred qualifications:
Strong understanding of organic synthesis, heat transfer, mass balance, and fluid dynamics.
Knowledge of cGMP and regulatory requirements for API manufacturing for clinical trials and commercial use
Excellent customer service skills
